transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been bothering you or what brings you here today?

Well… it’s mostly the wasps. I’ve gotten to where I plan my whole summer around avoiding them. I even stopped doing the garden jobs at church, and if I hear buzzing by the back porch, I make my husband unload things instead. It’s… gotten a bit much.
Are you also afraid of other animals or situations, or is your fear mostly limited to wasps?
Mostly wasps, yes. I mean… I know they’re just small insects, and other people don’t make such a fuss. But if one comes near me, it feels like something awful is about to happen.
When you encounter a wasp or hear one buzzing nearby, do you feel an intense surge of fear or panic that peaks within minutes?

Yes… it comes on right away. If I hear that sharp buzzing near the porch, or see one by the flowers, my heart sort of jumps and my hands start shaking. I just feel like I need to get inside immediately.
Do you feel anxious or fearful even when you're just thinking about encountering a wasp, even if one isn't around?

Yes… even just thinking about it can set me on edge. I know it’s only a little insect, and most people would just swat it away, but in my head it feels like something terrible could happen if one got near me.
Has your fear of wasps caused you significant distress or affected your ability to do things you normally would, like participating in activities at church or spending time outside with family?

Yes… it has. I don’t really like to make a big thing of it, but I’ve stepped back from the church gardening group, and I don’t host those garden days at home anymore. That used to be one of the ways I stayed connected with people.

And at home, my husband handles the porch and garden things now… things I used to just do myself.
How long have you felt this way about wasps? Has it been at least six months or more?
Yes… it’s been more than six months. It started after that remodel, when they uncovered the wasp nest. That was about… two years and five months ago.
